2026-10-19T05:04:48.0727624Z   pr_body: Refs #6038.

## Summary

I re-ran every row of the #6038 Evidence table against `main` (after #7547). Every row now blocks or asks. Probing further found one class of silent allows the earlier fixes missed: a directory builtin written behind a prefix that Bash still runs in the current shell.

| Command (scenario B: session checkout on `main`, worktree on merged `feature/x`) | `main` | this PR |
|---|---|---|
| `time -p cd <wt> && git push origin HEAD:feature/x` (also `time cd`, `time -p -- cd`, `time cd -- <wt>`) | allow | **block** |
| `command -p cd <wt> && git push …` | allow | **block** |
| `time` / `builtin` / `command` / `X=1` + `pushd <wt> && git push …` | allow | ask |
| `time` / `builtin` / `command` / `X=1` + `eval 'cd <wt>'; git push …` | allow | ask |
| `time source f`, `builtin source f`, `command . f`, then `git push …` | allow | ask |
| `builtin enable -n cd; cd <wt>; git push …` | allow | ask |

Bash confirms each of these changes the directory (`bash -c 'cd /; time -p cd /tmp; pwd'` prints `/tmp`).

**Root cause:** `_guarded_git_invocations` only spotted a directory change when the builtin was the segment's first word. `_cd_command_words` also skipped `VAR=` and plain `builtin` / `command`, but nothing else. With the prefix in front, the hook judged the clean session checkout and allowed the push.

## Changes

- `.claude/hooks/pr_merge_status_guard.py` and `workflow-templates/.claude/hooks/pr_merge_status_guard.py` (byte-identical):
  - New `_shell_builtin_view` strips `VAR=` assignments, `builtin`, `command [-p]` and `time [-p] [--]`. `command -v` / `-V` and unknow
